# Prybambas

> Free thinking games for curious kids ages 5–14: cause-and-effect logic, TRIZ inventor puzzles and language practice. In the browser, no login, no ads, 15 languages. Made by Kids Skill Academy.

## Games

- [What If?](https://prybambas.com/what-if/): cause-and-effect logic game. Modes: single question (discuss a crazy what-if event), logical chain (guess where a fact leads, reveal the hidden chain), deduction (work back from a consequence to its cause).
- [Inventor Lab](https://prybambas.com/inventor/): TRIZ for kids — 8 invention tools (Segmentation, Nesting, Merging, Asymmetry, Feedback, Self-Service, Copying, Color Change) with real examples, a 30-day observation calendar, challenges by tool, missions at Rookie / Agent / Elite level.
- [AI Coach](https://prybambas.com/coach/): language practice space that pairs with the One Verb a Day workbooks.
- [Books Gym](https://prybambas.com/book/): printed workbooks that match the games.

## Who it's for

Children ages 5–14, parents, homeschoolers, teachers, multilingual families.

## Languages

Games: English, Ukrainian, Romanian, Polish, German, French, Italian, Swedish, Finnish, Danish, Spanish, Portuguese, Hebrew, Japanese, Arabic.
Ideas and shop: English, Ukrainian, Polish, German, Spanish.

## Printed workbooks (Kids Skill Academy, on Amazon)

- [What If?](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GXNWFZ6N): 100+ logic puzzles about cause and effect.
- [Think Like an Inventor](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FLKJV2PX): 4 volumes of hands-on TRIZ missions.
- [One Verb a Day](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FT96B31H): active-recall language workbooks with audio codes.
- [Microscope Safari](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H6H4RRBT): guided science journal for pocket microscopes.
